newsitem.title: USA: Food Lion sees Kash n' Karry synergies ahead.
newsitem.headline: Food Lion sees Kash n' Karry synergies ahead.

text.p: Food Lion Inc said it will take several quarters to realize the synergies it expects to achieve from its Kash n' Karry acquisition.

The company said Kash n' Karry's operations were included in Food Lion's operating results for the first quarter ended March 22, reducing company earnings by $0.01 per share. Food Lion said Kash n' Karry operations are expected to perform at this level until the fourth quarter 1997 when new marketing initiatives and operational efficiencies are expected to come to fruition.
Food Lion earned $0.10 a share in its first quarter, a slight increase over last year's $0.09 per share.
As previously announced, Food Lion said Kash n' Karry will close seven underperforming stores during the second quarter of this year.
